cohort: The study included 200 patients who underwent various abdominal and pelvic surgeries, including lower segment cesarean sections, total abdominal hysterectomies, ovarian cancer surgery, myomectomy, ovarian cystectomy, and laparotomy for ectopic pregnancy.
finding: The primary finding was that no adhesions were present on repeat surgery among the 12 re-operated patients who had received hyaluronic acid gel.
mod_finding: Among the patients undergoing repeat cesarean sections, no adhesions were found at the previous incision site.
followup_time: Up to 1 year (for re-operated patients) and 6 months (for general symptoms follow-up)
